name: run-interactive-session
description: Perform interactive testing on Kobiton devices using natural language. Translates user intents into CLI commands - WebDriver actions (find elements, type, click, swipe), device operations (adb shell, screen capture, port forwarding), file management (push/pull), app management, and test execution. Use when the user wants to interact with a mobile device on Kobiton, run exploratory tests, inspect device state, manage files on a device, or execute test sessions - even if they don't say "interactive test" explicitly. Trigger with "interact with kobiton device", "explore on kobiton", or "tap/swipe on device".
